batches_ci_fix_idx.name: batches_ci_fix_idx
batches_ci_fix_idx.where: ci_fix_of IS NOT NULL AND ci_fix_head IS NOT NULL

batches_one_unfinished.name: batches_one_unfinished
batches_one_unfinished.where: state IN ('CUTTING', 'OPEN', 'SHIPPING', 'FAILED') AND worktree_path IS NULL

routing_rules_scope.name: routing_rules_scope
routing_rules_scope.value:
("routing_rules"."category" IS NULL) <> ("routing_rules"."topic" IS NULL)
        AND ("routing_rules"."goal_id" IS NULL OR "routing_rules"."task_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("routing_rules"."topic" IS NULL OR ("routing_rules"."goal_id" IS NULL AND "routing_rules"."task_id" IS NULL AND "routing_rules"."area" IS NULL))
        AND ("routing_rules"."task_id" IS NULL OR "routing_rules"."area" IS NULL)

shape_links_one_target.name: shape_links_one_target
shape_links_one_target.value: ("shape_links"."goal_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("shape_links"."task_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("shape_links"."decision_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("shape_links"."principle_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("shape_links"."question_id" IS NOT NULL) = 1
